# Whole-graph integration

Integrated root plus eight canonical children, each with mechanism/procedure,
troubleshooting and source-map links. Root routes install -> dispatch -> operator,
memory -> graph/HCCL, training -> graph/distributed and profiling -> completion/
ownership without moving specialized depth into the root. Three safe helpers
use package APIs or standard-library contract checks and need no source checkout.
Original build/codegen/CI source scripts remain classified with concrete reasons.

Duplicate allocator tuning was avoided: existing device/pinned-host owners keep
their earlier pin and are declared as metadata relationships. Newer allocator
reading supports cross-stream and capture operating contracts without rewriting
those owners. Source default master and released compatibility remain distinct.

Whole-tree discovery, selected substantive reads, optional/absent submodules,
native candidates and long-tail gaps are explicit. Graph/script/metadata/link
checks ran only after complete integration. Backend-native checks remain blocked.
The final native stdlib version helper ran after integration, not during drafting.
